page_title: LYO 2-2 AUX | Lyon v Auxerre 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Theo Bair (Auxerre) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jeremy Stinat no option but to blow his whistle.
90+7' Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

90+6' A sweet pass finds Theo Bair (Auxerre) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Lucas Perri is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
90+3' Yellow card. Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90+2' Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Elisha Owusu trots off the pitch and is replaced by Assane Diousse (Auxerre).
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.

90' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) inside the box. He lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Donovan Leon was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
89' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
89' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
85' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Sael Kumbedi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon).
84' Christophe Pelissier is forced to make a change. Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Ado Onaiwu.
82' Wilfried Zaha (Lyon) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Donovan Leon.
80' Donovan Leon (Auxerre) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
80' The corner is swung in but Lyon can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Georges Mikautadze will be replaced by Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Wilfried Zaha (Lyon) coming on for Nemanja Matic.
72' 2 - 2 Goal! Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) deflects a shot with his body past the goalkeeper. Here is an example of luck being on your side. 2:2.
70' Flag up against Gideon Mensah (Auxerre). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
69' Here is a change. Said Benrahma is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon).
69' Half-chance! Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) plays a pass into the box, but Lucas Perri reacts well to snuff out the attack.
67' Christophe Pelissier has decided to make a change. Theo Bair (Auxerre) replaces Gaetan Perrin.
67' Florian Aye comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre).
65' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
65' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) fires the ball to the top left corner, but Lucas Perri saves it.
62' 2 - 1 Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the right post.
60' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle and it's Rayan Raveloson (Auxerre) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
59' Referee Jeremy Stinat signals NO PENALTY for Lyon after a VAR review!

58' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Lyon.
57' Malick Fofana (Lyon) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
56' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jeremy Stinat who sees an offensive foul.
54' The linesman raises his flag. Said Benrahma (Lyon) is adjudged offside.
53' The linesman signals that Florian Aye (Auxerre) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

53' Malick Fofana (Lyon) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Donovan Leon blocks the shot with his legs.
51' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
51' Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre).

47' 1 - 1 A perfectly taken corner kick. Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes inside the right post, increasing the score of today's match – 1:1.
47' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
47' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
46' The game is over for Kevin Danois (Auxerre). Rayan Raveloson comes on for the second half.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+16' The match has reached half-time.
45+15' Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lucas Perri, who smothers the ball.
45+13' Malick Fofana (Lyon) is adjudged offside.
45+13' One of the Auxerre players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
45+9' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
45+8' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+7' What was Jubal (Auxerre) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45+5' 1 - 0 Goal! Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) puts the penalty low into the middle of the goal and past Donovan Leon.
45+5' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45' 15 additional min. will be played.
44' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
44' The Lyon players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
43' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Lyon! Let's see what he decides.
41' Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
33' Malick Fofana (Lyon) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
27' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

26' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes just wide of the right post.
25' The game is interrupted now, Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
24' Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Sael Kumbedi (Lyon).
22' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
19' Malick Fofana (Lyon) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
18' The game is interrupted as Florian Aye (Auxerre) is flagged offside.
17' Malick Fofana (Lyon) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul.

16' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top left corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
16' There's an opportunity for Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
15' The corner from Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) is cleared away by the defence.
15' A cross into the box from Malick Fofana (Lyon) is cleared.
12' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
11' Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
1' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lyon will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will referee today's match.
